title: The Pearl Diver's Thirds
story: In a glowing tidepool cavern, Quorlbath the Tidepool Hoarder has stuffed the village's rescued pearls into three bulging cheek pouches. Mr 6 wades in, cape floating, and offers a deal: if he can name the exact number of pearls, Quorlbath must spit them all back. The hoarder grins — he thinks nobody can count what they can't see.
question: Quorlbath swallowed 288 pearls. He spat back 1/4 of them at dawn, then 1/3 of what remained at noon. How many pearls are still inside Quorlbath?
hint: Find one quarter of 288 first, and subtract it. THEN take a third of that new, smaller number — not of 288.
victory: Mr 6 said "one hundred forty-four, and I'd like them polished," and Quorlbath burped out every last pearl in astonishment. He now works as the tidepool's official pearl-counter, and he's terrible at it.
imagePrompt: A round, puff-cheeked sea hoarder crouched in a glowing turquoise tidepool cavern, pearls spilling from its pouches, as a small knightly numeral 6 with a blue cape stands on a wet rock pointing confidently.
